text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu was invited as a guest to an 
event at the racecourse.

Having decided to participate in the 
exhibition race, she dashed gallantly 
across the track—
A flawless victory, just like always—!
choice_data_list: That was an amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I know. This body knows better than 
anyone.
choice_data_list: いい走りだった！

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu remained silent, as if 
savoring the taste of victory, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It seems my glove is fraying. I'll need 
to have it mended."
choice_data_list: どうかした？

text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Ramonu looked down at the glove on 
her left hand. Watching her do so, a 
thought suddenly crossed my mind."
choice_data_list:
(So it's asymmetrical on the left and 
right, huh?)

(So it's asymmetrical on the left and 
right.)

text_block_list.text:
Parts of her racing outfit, such as her 
gloves and stockings, are asymmetrical.
choice_data_list: （左右で非対称になってるのか）
（左右で非対称になってるんだ）

text_block_list.text:
It's surprising for someone who pursues 
perfection. Could there be a reason why 
she chose an asymmetrical design?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...You've had a strange look on your face 
for a while now.
choice_data_list: Ah, umm...

text_block_list.text:
I decided to frankly ask the question that 
had just crossed my mind.
choice_data_list: あ、ええと……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Eyes like a little kitten.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right. What I think is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Perfect love is like a flame.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Not for a single instant does it hold the 
same shape. Growing, shrinking, 
flickering, and blazing intensely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because of that range— 
that things never fall into a rut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That is why I also... intentionally allow 
for some variance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
While I always feel the urge to pursue it, 
I must not let myself become 
oversaturated...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Without stagnating or running dry— to 
continue realizing a perfect love.
choice_data_list: (I see...?)

text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if I fully understood it, 
but...
choice_data_list: （なるほど……？）

text_block_list.text:
I can understand the desire to create 
dynamic flair through asymmetry and keep 
things from becoming monotonous.
choice_data_list: So that's your love for racing.
So that's your love for racing, isn't it.

Passion and bashfulness… something like 
that, I guess?

text_block_list.text:

dynamic flair through asymmetry and keep 
things from becoming monotonous.

情熱と恥じらい……みたいなことかな？
choice_data_list_en: That's your love for racing, huh.
That's your love for racing, isn't it?
Passion and shyness... something like that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...You speak as if this doesn't concern 
you at all.
choice_data_list: それが、君のレースに対する愛なんだな
それが、貴方のレースに対する愛なんだね
情熱と恥じらい……みたいなことかな？
choice_data_list_en: That's your love for racing, huh.
That's your love for racing, isn't it?
Passion and shyness... something like that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I thought there would be a spark of fire 
inside you as well, though."
choice_data_list: え？

text_block_list.text:
A spark, you say... Do you mean that I 
must still love racing deep down?
choice_data_list: Maybe they just express love differently.

Maybe their way of showing love is just 
different.

text_block_list.text:
It must be different from her perspective 
as the one actually running. I told her 
that watching peacefully might just be my 
own way of engaging with racing.
choice_data_list: 愛し方が違うのかもな
愛し方が違うのかもね
choice_data_list_en: Maybe the way they show love is just different.
Maybe the way they show love is just different.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Your love is truly as vast as a 
mighty river.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Bashfulness? You sound just like a 
child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Innocent love is beautiful. ...Yet, being 
pure alone isn't enough to understand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Only by being seared, roasted, and 
surrendering to chaos... can one truly 
feel something profound.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Only by casting aside that naive 
innocence... can one reach the absolute 
summit.

It seems the word 'shyness' has no place 
in her love for racing. I found myself 
thinking how truly characteristic of her 
that was.
